provenance.source: curated move catalog and character guides from budok-ai

summary.game_plan: Mutant is an aggressive rushdown character with acid damage-over-time.
tips: Getting in: AcidSlashJ (Leap Slash, travels ~150 units, 10-hit), DashThroughAttack (Sneak Attack, dashes through opponent), WallTrick (Pounce, ~200 units). Also use Dash/Walk Forward — Mutant NEEDS to be close.
At close range (<60 units): Swipe (h_reach 44, fast), Sweep (49, knockdown), BiteGrab (40, applies poison DoT — grabs beat blocking). Mix Swipe/Grab unpredictably.
At range: CausticSpike (250, acid projectile). Use to force opponent to approach.
Key strategy: Apply acid with AcidSlashH/BiteGrab, then stay aggressive. Acid DoT does damage over time so pressure counts. GroundToAirSpin (Shred, 9 hits) for big damage.
Movement is essential. Most Mutant attacks are short range. If >60 units away, close distance before attacking. Don't throw Swipe at 150 units — it will whiff.
Mutant is NOT a defensive character. Blocking wastes your speed advantage.

AcidSlashH.summary: Horizontal Acid Slash — acid-coated slash, applies acid DoT.
AcidSlashH.beats: applies damage over time on hit

AcidSlashJ.summary: Leap Slash — leaping acid slash covering ~150 units, 10-hit. Effective range ~200 units. Great approach tool but committed.

AcidSlashV.summary: Vertical Acid Slash — aerial acid slash.

AirGrab.loses_to: loses to air attacks, requires both players airborne

AirSpin.summary: Aerial Shred — multi-hit aerial spin (6 hits).

BiteGrab.summary: Envenom — poison bite grab, applies damage over time.
BiteGrab.beats: blocking opponents, poison DoT adds extra damage
BiteGrab.loses_to: very slow, loses to any attack

CausticBarrage.summary: Caustic Barrage — acid barrage super. Costs meter.

CausticSpike.summary: Caustic Spike — acid projectile. Direction payload.

ChargeDash.summary: Super Dash — armored dash forward, covers large distance. Startup 8 ticks, actionable after ~22 ticks. Goes through single-hit attacks. Best option for closing large distances (200+ units).
ChargeDash.beats: goes through single-hit attacks (armor), covers the most ground of any movement. Use when FAR from opponent to close the gap.
ChargeDash.loses_to: 8 tick startup (slow), loses to grabs and multi-hit moves. Punishable if predicted.

Dash.summary: Dash — quick forward hop. Startup 1 tick (fastest movement option), actionable after ~10 ticks. Projectile invulnerable frames 0-4, hops over low attacks. Use to close distance quickly or dodge projectiles.
Dash.beats: projectiles (invuln frames 0-4), low attacks (hops over). Fastest way to close distance.
Dash.loses_to: short distance covered, loses to well-timed attacks.

DashBackward.summary: Walk Back — retreat from opponent. Startup 2 ticks, actionable after ~11 ticks. Grab immune frames 1-7. Becomes inactionable if opponent uses forward movement.
DashBackward.beats: escapes close-range pressure, grab immune early frames. Creates space for zoning.
DashBackward.loses_to: gives up stage position, can get cornered at stage edge. Inactionable if opponent dashes forward.

DashForward.summary: Walk Forward — close distance toward opponent. Distance payload (0-100) controls how far. Startup 2 ticks, actionable after ~10-15 ticks. Essential for getting into attack range when your moves can't reach.
DashForward.beats: closes gap so your attacks can connect. Use when OUT OF RANGE for melee attacks. Walk into attack range, THEN attack next turn.
DashForward.loses_to: vulnerable during movement, predictable if repeated. Opponent can anti-air or attack your approach.

DashThroughAttack.summary: Sneak Attack — dashes through opponent and attacks. Covers ~150 units. Crosses up, confuses blocking direction.
DashThroughAttack.loses_to: predictable if overused, loses to fast reactions

DefensiveBurst.summary: Burst — invincible reversal, costs burst stock. Emergency escape.
DefensiveBurst.loses_to: limited stock (usually 1-2 per match), huge loss if baited

DoubleJump.summary: Double Jump — second jump while airborne. Changes your air trajectory. Use to extend airtime, dodge anti-airs, or reposition in the air.
DoubleJump.beats: dodges anti-airs by changing trajectory, extends air control.
DoubleJump.loses_to: uses your air action, can't double jump again.

Fall.summary: Fall — drop from the air quickly. Use to land faster and become actionable sooner instead of floating. Good after a whiffed air attack or to bait anti-airs.
Fall.beats: lands quickly to act sooner, baits anti-airs that expect you to stay airborne.

ForwardDashFollowup.summary: Follow-up attack after a forward dash. Good for closing distance and attacking.

Grab.summary: Throw — beats blocking, loses to attacks. h_reach ~50 units. Must be close to opponent to connect. If opponent is out of range, close distance first with DashForward or Dash.
Grab.loses_to: loses to attacks (any attack beats grab), very short range (~50 units). Will whiff if opponent is further than 50 units.

GroundToAirSpin.summary: Shred — multi-hit spinning attack (9 hits), ground-to-air.
GroundToAirSpin.beats: massive damage if it connects, multi-hit pressure

InstantCancel.summary: Cancel current move animation instantly. Costs meter.

JukeCharge.summary: Howl — charges juke pips (defense resource). Costs meter.

Jump.summary: Jump — become airborne. JumpArc payload controls trajectory (x: horizontal direction, y: height). Startup 2-5 ticks. Short jumps actionable in ~10 ticks, high jumps ~15. Avoids grabs and ground attacks. Enables aerial attacks on landing.
Jump.beats: avoids ALL grabs and ground-only attacks. Repositions vertically. Use to approach over projectiles or escape grab pressure.
Jump.loses_to: predictable landing trajectory, vulnerable to anti-airs (UpwardSwipe). Aerial blocking is weaker than ground blocking (+2 block disadvantage).

OffensiveBurst.summary: Burst Cancel — cancel current attack into pressure. Costs burst.
OffensiveBurst.loses_to: costs burst stock, wasted if not in an attack

OverheadClaw.summary: Overhead Claw — overhead attack, hits high.

ParryAfterWhiff.summary: Block after a whiffed attack. Same as ParryHigh but in recovery.

ParryHigh.summary: Block high/mid attacks. Parry timing count sets active parry frames (1-20).
ParryHigh.loses_to: loses to grabs, does no damage

ParrySuper.summary: Push Block — costs meter, creates distance on block.

ProjectileGrab.summary: Vault — aerial grab that goes over projectiles.

Rebirth.summary: Rebirth — revival/comeback super, very high damage. Costs meter.
Rebirth.loses_to: extremely slow, short range, costs meter

Roll.summary: Dodge — invincible roll. Has invincibility frames that avoid all attacks. Good for escaping pressure or dodging predictable attacks. Direction is usually fixed.
Roll.beats: attacks (invincible frames), projectiles, repositions while safe.
Roll.loses_to: vulnerable after invincibility ends, loses to delayed attacks and grabs.

Slash.summary: Slash — strong claw slash. Solid mid-range option.

SpotDodge.summary: Spot Dodge — stationary invincible dodge. Grab invulnerable frames 1-4, fully invulnerable frames 5-7, actionable at frame 11. Beats both attacks and grabs briefly. Very fast recovery allows punishing after dodging.
SpotDodge.beats: avoids attacks AND grabs without moving. Fast recovery (11 ticks) lets you punish after dodging.
SpotDodge.loses_to: loses to attacks that hit after frame 7 (delayed attacks, multi-hit moves). Short invulnerability window.

SuperJump.summary: Super Jump — high/far jump covering more distance than normal jump. JumpArc payload controls arc. Startup 5 ticks. Covers large horizontal and vertical distance. Use for big repositioning or escaping corner pressure.
SuperJump.beats: escapes pressure, covers large distance, avoids grabs and ground attacks.
SuperJump.loses_to: longer airtime makes landing predictable. Vulnerable to anti-airs.

Sweep.summary: Sweep — high damage sweep attack. Knockdown on hit.
Sweep.beats: opponents standing or blocking high, causes knockdown
Sweep.loses_to: loses to jumping, punishable on block

Swipe.summary: Swipe — basic claw swipe. Fast and reliable.

SwipeDown.summary: Low Swipe — low sweeping claw. Hits low.

SwipeUp.summary: Upward Swipe — anti-air claw. Use when opponent is airborne.
SwipeUp.loses_to: whiffs vs grounded opponents at distance

Taunt.summary: Hustle/taunt — builds meter but leaves you vulnerable.
Taunt.loses_to: fully vulnerable during animation, punishable at any range

TechRoll.summary: Tech Dodge — invincible roll on knockdown. Use when knocked down to escape wakeup pressure. Repositions while invincible.
TechRoll.beats: avoids wakeup pressure (meaties, grabs on your wakeup).
TechRoll.loses_to: direction is predictable, opponent can read and chase.

TwistAttack.summary: Corkscrew — spinning multi-hit attack. Direction payload.

Wait.summary: Do nothing this turn. Low commitment, preserves options.
Wait.loses_to: gives up initiative, opponent acts freely

WallTrick.summary: Pounce — wall pounce attack covering ~200 units, 7-hit combo potential. Requires wall nearby.
WallTrick.loses_to: requires wall nearby, punishable if read

WhiffInstantCancel.summary: Cancel a whiffed move. Costs meter.
